featured_reviews.name: Sameer Ghadi
featured_reviews.review_text:
5/5 Stars – Perfect Maharashtrian Catering for Ganesh Jayanti Feast!
We ordered from Santosh Catering for Ganesh Jayanti on 22-01-2026, and it was flawless! Parcel service for lunch (30 people) and dinner (50 people) – both deliveries were super smooth and right on time.
Lunch Menu (30 pax): Paneer Lazeez, Sukha Batata Bhaji, Chapati (3 per person), Jeera Rice, Dal Fry, Koshimbir, Papad, Achar. Every item was delicious, fresh, and packed with authentic Maharashtrian flavors – the Paneer Lazeez was a highlight! Best part: completely soda-free (no baking soda powder), so all tastes were pure and natural.
Dinner Menu (50 pax): Veg Kolhapuri, Bhendi Masala, Chapati (3 per person), Jeera Rice, Dal Fry, Koshimbir, Papad, Achar. The Veg Kolhapuri had the perfect spicy kick, and portions were generous for our big group – again, soda-free for genuine flavors.
Prices are very reasonable for the quality and variety, making it ideal for celebrations. Highly recommend – Santosh Catering nailed it!

featured_reviews.name: Raviraj Samant
featured_reviews.review_text:
Positives:
1. The food taste was good.
2. The decoration was nice.

Negatives:
1. The manager literally coerced me to give a 5 star review. Well! You better give me a good service for that but HELL NO! THEY DIDN'T!
2. The servers with starters just did NOT come to the row where we were seated, which was RIGHT NEXT to where they were entering from.
3. I told the manager herself, and the other boy who was sub-manager, not once or twice but multiple times, and even then they didn't give us starters even 1 damn time!
4. I agree, we were here for the function and not just for the food. But if you are behind my back for a review, might as well provide a good service.

So overall, I really would not recommend their services. I'm sorry, if you check my other reviews I am mostly very considerate.

But these guys just didn't listen to my request at all. They just kept on bringing water and juice. What do you want me to do? Overdose on liquids and keep peeing?

Also there were barely any chairs for us to have lunch. And I had to keep my plate next to the person who was collecting used plates. Nice!

So my sincere request to them is that please instruct your robotic like serving staff to apply some brains as to where to serve next instead of going to the same place like ants. While I agree that every profession should be respected but then do it properly and not for the sake of it or atleast your manager should observe it.

1 star is for their taste of food and the other is for the decoration. That's it. You asked me how were the starters without even serving me and gave me 1 paneer tikka to review and never to come back again. 😂 Hilarious!

featured_reviews.name: Azania Thomas
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Kaizad Patel — what can I say? There truly aren’t enough words to encapsulate the sumptuous wedding food he prepared for our reception. The experience was nothing short of unforgettable.

From the very beginning, Kaizad was accessible, professional, and instinctively understood exactly what a wedding crowd would love — from the starters right through to the main course. He is a culinary genius with an extraordinary eye for detail.

The care, precision, and attention to detail were evident not only in the flavours but also in the service and presentation. Every dish was served with clockwork timing, thoughtfulness, and respect for the occasion. The coordination, calm service flow, and seamless execution made guests feel truly looked after.

The patra nu macchi was absolutely delectable — with the perfect balance of spice and sweetness in the chutney, beautifully wrapped and steamed in a banana leaf. The pulao daal had just the right thickness, wholesomeness, and warmth. The sali jardalu(apricot) chicken was rich, comforting, and perfectly textured. The lagan nu custard was nutty, gently cinnamony, and deeply satisfying. One can go
on..

A particularly thoughtful touch was the bhonas, which were sent promptly between 2–4 pm on the day of our reception to guests who were unwell or unable to attend. That level of care meant so much, and everyone who ate his food had a truly memorable experience.

The thali selection was outstanding and thoughtfully inclusive for vegetarian and Jain guests. Having undhiyu available in winter was a rare and wonderful treat, and the overall spread was exceptional. In fact, a few people told us they came to the wedding especially for his food — which says it all!

Kaizad also caters for Navroz, weddings, and other festive occasions. If you’re looking for unforgettable wedding or festive catering, his cuisine is simply unmatched.

featured_reviews.name: Training Test
featured_reviews.review_text:
Title: Disaster in Disguise: Avoid M Talwar Catering Services at All Costs

I recently had the misfortune of using M Talwar Catering Services for my event, and it was an absolute disaster from start to finish. Where do I even begin?

Firstly, their communication was atrocious. It was like pulling teeth to get a response from them, and when they finally did reply, it was vague and unhelpful. It's like they didn't even care about their customers' needs or concerns.

When the day of the event finally arrived, I was horrified by the quality of the food. It was bland, tasteless, and looked like it had been sitting out for hours. It was evident that no effort or care had been put into preparing it. Guests were left hungry and disappointed, and some even complained of stomachaches afterward.

To add insult to injury, the presentation was laughable. The dishes looked sloppy and unappetizing, as if they were thrown together in a hurry by someone who had no clue about food presentation.

But the cherry on top of this disastrous experience was the unprofessionalism of the staff. They were rude, disorganized, and seemed completely indifferent to the chaos unfolding around them. It was clear that they had no idea what they were doing.

In conclusion, M Talwar Catering Services is a complete and utter joke. Do yourself a favor and steer clear of them unless you want your event to be a total embarrassment. Save yourself the headache and find a catering company that actually cares about their customers and knows how to deliver quality service.
